notes: Reads back BPL while the Bode plot application is active (FW 03.000); BPL is not in the manual's value list.
Applications are exclusive: in BPL mode, bus decode and other settings fail with -221 'Settings conflict'. Switch with DEV:MODE YT.
Leaving the Bode application turns the generator output off.
Returns -113 'Undefined header' on FW 03.000.

Only reliable when BUS<b>:TYPE matches this protocol. FW 03.000 is inconsistent: I2C queries on an SSPI bus give -200 'Execution error' and no response, SPI queries on a UART bus return empty data with no error. Check BUS<b>:TYPE? first.
Frame numbers <n> start at 1; frame count from ...:FCOunt?. Batched field reads run at about 180-230 frames/s (5-6 fields per frame).
Observed values include OK and INS (insufficient: frame not fully inside the acquisition).
The history may hold fewer segments than requested (50 requested -> 40 available at 10 kSa); read ACQuire:AVAilable?.
The maximum depends on the record length: 40 and 100 were rejected (-222) where 16 was the limit.
Out-of-range segment indexes are clamped silently (no error). Valid range: HISTory:STARt? .. HISTory:STOP? (0 = newest).
Returns hour,minute,second triples per segment; dates come from ...:TSDate:ALL? as year,month,day triples.
MAX/DMAX only take effect while stopped. At 6 MSa, REAL,32 transfers 24 MB in ~1.4 s; UINT,16 is lossless for the 10-bit ADC at half the size.
Volts = YORigin + YINCrement * code for UINT formats (verified FW 03.000). FORMat is not part of SYSTem:SET.
Returns the full statistics buffer (~1000 values). 9.91E+37 means 'no value' (NaN).

Query returns the complete setup as a ~5 kB block; sending it back (SYST:SET #<block>) restores it in ~1 s. Does not include FORMat.
Present although missing from SYSTem:TREE? on FW 03.000. PNG 1280x824, ~45 kB, ~0.7 s.
Honours FORMat; ASCii rounds to 4 significant digits, use REAL,32. Poll BPLot:STATe? until STOP after a RUN.
The manual lists THReshold and THReshold:UDLevel as one command. On FW 03.000 THReshold takes the mode (TTL|ECL|CMOS|USER) and THReshold:UDLevel takes the user level in volts.

add_command.summary:
User-defined threshold level of the logic pod, used when LOGic

:THReshold is USER.
notes: Bench-verified on FW 03.000: LOG1:THR USER; LOG1:THR:UDL 0.5 for the ~1 V pattern-generator outputs.
The firmware also lists UDLevel2; presumably the level for the upper nibble of the pod (unverified).

Not a relay: the generator always has a 50 ohm source impedance. R50 tells it a 50 ohm load is connected, so the amplitude you set appears at the load; HIGHz assumes an open (1 Mohm) input. A Bode sweep leaves it at R50.
The RTB2 inputs are 1 Mohm only (no internal 50 ohm). For a 50 ohm system use an external feed-through terminator and set WGENerator:OUTPut:LOAD R50 when the generator drives it.

Serial patterns are fixed demo traffic, levels about 1 V (set the logic threshold to USER 0.5 V). I2C: P0 SCL, P1 SDA; writes '*idn?' to address 0x20 and reads 'Rohde&Schwarz - RTB2004'. SPI: P0 clock, P1 MOSI, P2 MISO, P3 CS (active low); MOSI 'Rohde&Schwarz' and 'RTB2004', MISO echoes one byte later. UART: P0 Tx, 115200 Bd, idle high, '*idn?\n'; decodes cleanest as 9 bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
COUNter drives a 4-bit up/down counter on P0..P3 at PGENerator:PATTern:COUNter:FREQuency. The serial data rate is not settable by remote command on FW 03.000.

BUS<b>:HISTory:EXPort writes only the segment timestamp table (CSV, same content as EXPort:ATABle), not decoded frames. Harvest decodes with the FRAMe queries per segment instead. Download the CSV with MMEMory:DATA?.

Selecting a segment re-runs the bus decode for that segment (about 190-240 ms per segment). Segmented memory uses a short record: keep the sample rate at least ~10x the bus bit rate or the per-segment decode is garbled.
Pod data: one value per sample, bit n = channel n of the pod (D0..D7 for pod 1). Use UINT,8: 7.5 MSa in about 0.9 s. With UINT,16 the pod value lands in the high byte.
MMEM:DATA? "name" returns a file from the current directory (MMEM:CDIR "/INT") as block data; about 1 ms for 1 kB.

Only works when WGENerator:FUNCtion is already ARB; otherwise -200 Execution error. Load order: WGEN:FUNC ARB, WGEN:ARB:FILE:NAME "/INT/<file>.CSV", WGEN:ARB:FILE:OPEN. The file is the scope's waveform CSV format: header 'in s,C1 in V', then time,value rows (2000 points verified); upload it with MMEMory:DATA.
RUN sometimes answers -221 Settings conflict after timebase changes. MASK:STAT OFF, one SINGle, then MASK:STAT ON / MASK:CHCopy again clears it.
With noise on the signal, use TRIGger:A:EDGE:FILTer:HFReject ON so the edge trigger does not fire on the falling slope; otherwise the trace sits 180 degrees off the mask.
FAILED keeps only the failing acquisitions in the history, so they can be examined afterwards (bench-verified).
